_doc: One entry per reference photo. 'pose' is where the photo was taken, in local metres (C in-game shows yours; Shift+C copies it as JSON). 'approx': true until the pose has been tuned so that the photo and the render line up at the building edges. Photos live in reference/photos/ and are never committed (Google copyright).
